ideas.title: Investigating Police Brutality in Minneapolis
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of force by law enforcement in Minneapolis, including the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti?
Is there a pattern of excessive use of force by federal agents in Minneapolis?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of police brutality in Minneapolis, and that further investigation is needed to hold law enforcement accountable.
